errors.text_span: като етикетите са разположени през една година
errors.evidence: The phrase "през една година" translates to "every other year". However, the x-axis has a label for every single year from 2008 to 2019.
The line point for the year 2010 is exactly on the 1.00% grid line, not 1.20%.
The value for 2014 is negative, approximately -0.1%. Stating a positive value of 0.40% is a significant error.

errors.text_span: От 2015 до 2016 година има спад до около -0.10%
errors.evidence: In the 2015-2016 period, the values are approximately -0.3% and -0.5% respectively. The lowest point in the chart is in 2016 at around -0.5%. The stated value of -0.10% is incorrect.
